bio: At Bizie Lizie you can choose from a modern brasserie dotted with vintage details or a swish, bordering on Baroque interior. However, those who find it difficult to make up their mind, may well find the amazing choice on the menu somewhat daunting! The menu that will find favour with lovers of nostalgic nosh features heart-warming brasserie fare, such as shrimp fritters, calf’s tongue in Madeira sauce or eels in sorrel....
